title: MessageStatus
description: JSON schema for message status from the RECIPIENT'S standpoint

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message.

recipientId.description: The unique identifier of the recipient of this message.

status.description: The status of the message, from the RECIPIENT'S standpoint
status.name: MessageStatusType

enum.name: READ
enum.description: The recipient has read the message.

enum.name: UNREAD
enum.description: The recipient has not read the message.

enum.name: ARCHIVED
enum.description: The recipient has archived the message.
